verdict.rationale: A search API could plausibly offer native scheduled or background jobs, such as recurring searches or monitors and alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only stateless request/response endpoints. Integration guides for n8n, Dify, and OpenClaw describe third-party automation and agent platforms calling the API, which are host-platform or user-side workarounds and earn no credit. No documented first-party capability exists for configuring autonomous background automations.
